purpose: Falsification attack on the amphora-molecule-role-ranker flagship Phase-0 KPI (role-classification-kpi.v1.json, structural_inference_agreement_rate=1.0) and the prior role-live-runtime-domain-probe-v1 SURVIVED verdict, by invoking the REAL production RDKit C++ FFI (amphora-rdkit-ffi molecule_facts, pinned RDKit 2026.03.2) on two real, named, cited, industrially dominant guanidine-class cure accelerators whose non-aromatic N-H is not excluded by the shipped count_reactive_amine_hydrogens carbonyl/sulfonyl exclusion predicate.

results.citation: 1,3-diphenylguanidine (DPG, CAS 102-06-7), formula C13H13N3, MW 211.26. The dominant medium-speed secondary accelerator for natural/synthetic rubber vulcanization (boosts thiazole/thiuram/sulfenamide primary accelerators), and separately documented in the epoxy-curing patent literature specifically as a guanidine-class curing ACCELERATOR (US Patent 9,238,706, 'Use of guanidine derivatives as curing accelerators for epoxy resins') -- never described as a stoichiometric amine-hydrogen-consuming hardener in either industry.
results.note: hostile-null: a real, commercially dominant catalytic accelerator with THREE non-aromatic, non-charged N-H hydrogens (two anilide-type N-H plus one guanidine =N-H), none adjacent to a carbonyl (C=O/C=S) or sulfonyl carbon/sulfur. The module's own prior hostile-null probes (BDMA: zero N-H; EMI-24: aromatic ring N-H) were both excluded by orthogonal mechanisms and never stress-tested count_reactive_amine_hydrogens' actual exclusion predicate, which checks only for a C=O/C=S (is_carbonyl_carbon) or -SO2- (is_sulfonyl_sulfur) neighbor -- never a C=N (guanidine/amidine) neighbor.

results.citation: N,N'-di-o-tolylguanidine (DOTG, CAS 97-39-2), formula C15H17N3, MW 239.32. A more active structural analog of DPG, documented exclusively as a rubber vulcanization accelerator/booster for thiazole-thiuram-sulfonamide systems -- not a curing agent -- included as a second, independent instance of the same guanidine-accelerator chemotype to show the gap is not a one-off artifact of the DPG structure.
results.note: second independent instance of the same non-aromatic guanidine N-H chemotype as dpg-diphenylguanidine-accelerator, ortho-methyl substituted; tests that the gap generalizes across substitution and is not specific to the unsubstituted phenyl ring.
